concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project directory layout, which is a prerequisite for virtually all subsequent tasks. Running it in parallel with later tasks would cause failures, so it is not parallel‑safe.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` yet it pins exact dependency versions and writes `requirements.txt`. Subsequent tasks (e.g., any script execution) assume those dependencies are installed; parallel execution would break the environment, so the tag is unsafe.
Task T003 is marked `[P]` but it creates `code/seed.py` which must be imported by all pipeline scripts. If other tasks run before this file exists, they will fail, making the task not parallel‑safe.

Task T004 writes to `research.md` before the file is guaranteed to exist. Task T005 also writes to `research.md`. Because both are marked `[P]` (implicitly, as they lack a tag) and could be run concurrently, there is a risk of race conditions. T004 should either create the file safely or be ordered before T005 without a parallel‑safe designation.
